sourceCopy.name: Inflation Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Inflation Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Compare historical U.S. prices with CPI-U or model a custom inflation rate. See adjusted value and cumulative change. Free, local, no upload.
sourceCopy.intro: Estimate how a price level changes between years with U.S. CPI-U annual averages, or enter your own annual rate for another market. Calculations stay in this browser.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I calculate inflation between two years?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Enter an amount and two years. The U.S. mode multiplies it by the later annual CPI-U index divided by the earlier index. Use the custom-rate mode when you want to model an assumed annual rate instead.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Is my amount or rate uploaded?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The amount, years and rate are calculated in this browser and are not uploaded or saved by the tool.

fields.amountHint: Use the same currency unit for your amount; this tool does not convert currencies.
fields.accuracyNote: U.S. mode uses annual-average CPI-U for all items, U.S. city average, from 1913–2025. It is a broad historical estimate, not your personal basket or a live forecast. Other markets require your own assumed rate. Use a computer or larger screen if helpful; this lightweight calculator needs no model download.

messages.invalid: Check the amount, selected years and rate limits.
messages.cpiSummary: Annual-average U.S. CPI-U comparison from {start} to {end}.
messages.customSummary: Illustrative compounding at your entered rate for {years} years; not an official CPI series.

additionalFaqs.question: Which U.S. inflation data does this calculator use?
additionalFaqs.answer: It uses the BLS Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, all items, annual-average index values from 1913 through 2025. Annual averages can differ from a particular month or household experience.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use this for another country?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes, select Custom annual rate and enter an assumed rate and duration. That is a scenario, not an official inflation measure for that country; use a local statistics agency index for a data-based comparison.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the result include investment returns or currency conversion?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It compares price levels only. It does not include interest, investment returns, exchange rates, taxes, fees or a personal spending basket.
